Nina: ./run_debug --model codexica-36k-int4 --context 36000 --prefill tests/29k.txt --dump-kv --rotary-scale 1.0 --log debug
Ivy: observed symptom? duplicate/shift/drop?
Nina: duplicate small window then downstream shift. example: ref: "...motion carried without objection." -> int4: "...motion carried without objection. without objection."
Carlos: curious if RoPE scaling or quant rounding triggers comparator drift at the handshake boundary. can you dump KV fingerprints before/after handoff?
Nina: fp_before=3b7f9a12, fp_after=3b7f9a13 (1-bit diff) and logs show HANDSHAKE expected_next=28999 got_next=28998 then REPLAY idx=28997
Ivy: run cross-quant control (fp16,int8,int4) + rotary sweep around 0.9995..1.0005 and collect fingerprints. if only int4 fails it's likely packing bug; if all fail at certain rotary scales it's phase sensitivity.
